subject: Health Portal - Your $record_type is ready to view
body:
Dear $patient_name,

The health record you asked for ($record_type, $date_range) is ready.

For your privacy we do not send health information by e-mail. Sign in to the Health Portal to read it:

$portal_link

If you did not ask for this record, contact the Health Centre straight away on health@university.edu.

Best regards,
University Health Centre

$signature
